typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	CallList_Code as string (),
	DmccuPath as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		MemberNum as string,
		Phone as string,
		{Suggested DM Condition} as string,
		MemberSource as string,
		CustomUse as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CSVFile
CSVFile derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId sink(input(
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CUSTOMUSE as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CONDITION as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBER_SOURCE as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CUSTOMUSE = CustomUse,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CONDITION = {Suggested DM Condition},
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBER_SOURCE = MemberSource,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE = Phone)) ~> OLEDBDestination
